name: Zara
self_text: I am an American in my late 30s who loves growing chillies for the heat. I play Skyforge Arena on PC. I am looking for casual matches and someone to coach me. I am available weekday evenings, Saturday morning, or Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who coaches me. I'd strongly prefer that you are into Skyforge Arena, though it's not a requirement. It would be nice if you are available Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning or weekday evenings, but no big deal.
